about: MENVA Plus (PKR 99/month) and MENVA Black (PKR 599/month) launch posts. NOT scheduled: the app has no subscribe/checkout page yet. When it's live, swap these into a calendar like trend-bank posts (keep that post's n, day, date, weekday), or turn this file into a series-*.json with real days. Table 3D at partner restaurants stays free. Tiers are earned by visits, opt-in, never rupee amounts. Perks only as restaurants agree.

posts.caption:
MENVA has levels now.

Free: scan the QR at a partner table and the 3D is on us, same as always.
MENVA Plus, PKR 99/month: 3D and AR anywhere. Sofa, car park, the queue, 1 am "kal kahan chalein" research.
MENVA Black, PKR 599/month: the black badge, tiers you earn by showing up, and perks at partner restaurants as they join.

Kaunsa level ho tum? Link in bio.

posts.caption:
Not everyone gets the black badge.

MENVA Black, PKR 599/month. You climb the tiers by showing up at partner tables, not by flexing a bill: Regular, Known, Top Table, Legend. Leaderboard is opt-in, first names only, no amounts. Ever.

Perks at partner restaurants roll in as they join.
